description_en: Creates and starts instances in a batch
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone run-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecp.ce.large --image-id cpm-xxxx --security-group-id sg-xxxxx --vswitch-id vsw-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunInstances

parameters.help_en: The instance name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). Default value: the value of InstanceId
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。默认值为实例的InstanceId
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 实例的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The security group ID. The same security group as ECS is used
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID，与ECS使用相同的安全组
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The bandwidth value of the elastic IP address (EIP). Valid values: 1 to 200. Settings this parameter triggers the automatic creation of an EIP with the specified bandwidth, and the EIP is attached to the cloud phone instance. When the instance is released, the EIP is also released and revoked
parameters.help_zh: EIP带宽值，取值范围1-200。设置此参数，将自动创建对应带宽的EIP实例，并将EIP实例绑定到云手机实例。实例释放时，此EIP实例会一起释放回收
parameters.name: eip_bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The resolution of the cloud phone instance. You can call the DescribeInstanceTypes operation to query the resolutions supported by the current instance type and select an appropriate resolution
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例选用的分辨率，可通过DescribeInstanceTypes接口查询当前规格支持的分辨率列表，选择合适的分辨率
parameters.name: resolution

parameters.help_en:
The number of ECS instances that you want to create. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
指定创建ECS实例的数量。取值范围：1~100

默认值：1
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair for the cloud phone instance. You can call the ImportKeyPair operation to import a key pair
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例密钥对名称。可通过ImportKeyPair接口导入云手机密钥
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid (default): pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费方式。取值范围：

PrePaid：包年包月
PostPaid（默认）：按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription billing duration. Billable methods include subscription. Valid values:

Year
Month (default)
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月计费方式的时长单位。取值范围：

Year
Month（默认）
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. This parameter takes effect only when InstanceChargeType is set to PrePaid. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false (default): disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
是否要自动续费。当参数InstanceChargeType取值PrePaid时才生效。取值范围：

true：自动续费
false（默认）：不自动续费
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Default value: true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Default value: 1.
If PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1, 2, 3, and 6.
If PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5
parameters.help_zh:
周期时长，默认1。
PeriodUnit为Month时，支持1、2、3、6
PeriodUnit为Year时，支持1、2、3、4、5
parameters.name: period

fields.help_en: The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 实例的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 实例的标签值。N的取值范围为1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The private IP address of the cloud phone instance. When you specify a private IP address for the cloud phone instance, select an available IP address from the idle CIDR block of the vSwitch (VSwitchId).
Note:
If you set PrivateIpAddress, you must set Amount to 1, which indicates that only one cloud phone instance with the specified private IP address is created
parameters.help_zh:
云手机私网IP地址。云手机实例设置私网IP地址时，必须从虚拟交换机（VSwitchId）的空闲网段中选择。
您需要注意：
设置PrivateIpAddress后，Amount参数取值必须为1，表示为创建一台指定私网IP的云手机
parameters.name: private_ip_address
